title: Scam beware
body:
I authorised a £1 Apple Pay purchase on 7 September. I did not knowingly agree to a separate £14.99 charge that day or a £49.99 recurring subscription charge on 14 September.

I have contacted AskNebula asking them to cancel any subscription, stop further charges, refund the money and provide evidence of exactly where the £14.99 and £49.99 charges were clearly disclosed and agreed to before I authorised Apple Pay.

In my experience, the charging structure was not clear enough and I would strongly advise anyone using the app to check the payment terms very carefully before proceeding. They take money and do not let you know - beware it’s a scam. I’ve reported to Apple too.
developer_response:
Hello,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience — we truly appreciate your feedback. We’re sorry for the concern caused by the charge, particularly since you understood that you were authorising only the initial purchase.
We’d really like to look into this and help — please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com and our team will investigate the transactions, check the subscription details, and assist with your requests.
